apollo-csm-lm.dimsNote: sm_height_m excludes the SPS engine bell, which hangs inside the SLA. les_height_m is the escape system's own height; NASA does not say how much of it overlaps the CM (it sits on the CM's boost protective cover). SP-4029's summed component heights exceed its own total vehicle height by 1.8 m, so a stack built by summing is uncertain to about that much.
